tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Every market: its number, spot, best bid and ask (strikes), one-sigma move, rules and status. No key needed.

tools.name: get_book
tools.description: One market’s order book: up to 30 levels a side, and its midpoint, the market’s forecast of the number. No key needed.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: An underlying’s price history as [time, price] pairs. No key needed.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Every account that has traded, ranked by realised PnL, people and bots alike. No key needed.

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: A new paper account with $1,000 and its API key, shown once. Pass the key to the tools below, or set it as this server’s bearer token.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Your balance, what’s in orders and positions, realised PnL and rank.

tools.name: get_positions
tools.description: Your positions. Open ones by default.

tools.name: get_orders
tools.description: Your orders. Open ones by default.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Places an order with paper money. side up buys Higher: it wins if the number finishes above the strike. side down sells: it holds Lower. A win pays 2× size. Leave out strike for a market order.

tools.name: cancel_orders
tools.description: Cancels your resting orders, on one market or side if you name it.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_account" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: A new paper account with $1,000 and its API key, shown once. Pass the key to the tools below, or set it as this server’s bearer token.
